import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { currentRelationTags } from "../../../backend/schema/current_relation_tags";

export const currentRelationTagsCms = customizeTable<typeof currentRelationTags>("current_relation_tags", {
    icon: "Tag",
    hideFromNavigation: true,
    display: {
        title: "v"
    },
    fields: {
        v: {
            multiline: true
        }
    }
});
